item.title: Professor Neville de Mestre
item.description: Dear colleagues, IJCSS sadly informs that Emeritus Professor Neville de Mestre passed away 24 May 2022. Neville was for many years member of the Editorial Board of IJCSS. We are thankful for what he has done for the journal and will miss him greatly. Arnold Baca Editor-in-Chief
